title: Legal Contract Clause Refinement
business: Legal departments drafting high-volume standardized contracts.
problem: Initial drafts often contain inconsistent terminology or missing clauses that require multiple manual reviews, causing significant delays in deal finalization.
solution: An Evaluator-Optimizer loop automates the iterative refinement of contract clauses by using a generator LLM to draft content and an evaluator LLM to critique the draft against a predefined legal checklist, looping until the criteria are met.
steps: Define the specific legal criteria or checklist that a compliant contract clause must satisfy.
Configure the generator LLM to produce an initial draft based on the contract requirements.
Configure the evaluator LLM to compare the draft against the checklist and output specific feedback.
Implement a loop that passes the evaluator's feedback back to the generator for revision.
Set a termination condition, such as a maximum number of iterations or a successful evaluation pass.
outcome: Higher quality, consistent contract drafts that require minimal human intervention before final review.
limitation: The loop can increase latency and cost; check this by monitoring the average number of iterations required to reach a 'pass' state and ensuring it stays within acceptable time bounds.
